title: Appropriations: Military and Healthcare reach only your field and hand
notes: The owner's request (#4666): C+ #40 Appropriations' Military and Healthcare stop reaching the deck and cover only your Units on the field and in your hand, and in return they and Culture get back the numbers #3996 and #4154 took, on both faces; Education is unchanged. Military gives +(2X−2) Attack and Rush [+(4X−3)], Healthcare +(2X−2) Health and Armor X [+(5X−1), Armor 2X], Culture 6X% [16X%] over your field, hand and deck: v0.6.5b's numbers (R3996201). Education keeps ⌊5X/3⌋−2 [⌊17X/5⌋−2] (R4154105). The script through v0.6.12b is kept as `script_v0_6_12b` (R767000). Ruling R4666000.

player.title: Appropriations
balance: Appropriations' Military gives +(2X−2) Attack and Rush, up from +(⌊5X/3⌋−2). Radiant: +(4X−3), up from +(⌊17X/5⌋−4).
Appropriations' Healthcare gives +(2X−2) Health and Armor X, up from +(⌊5X/3⌋−2) Health. Radiant: +(5X−1) Health and Armor 2X, up from +⌊17X/5⌋ Health.
